findings.failure_scenario: The maind marketplace entry is archived to ~/.claude/plugins/cache/swissknifeman/maind/<version>/. check_plugin only reads plugin.json, hooks/hooks.json and commands/*.md, and only for ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}. The copy still contains executable climbs out of the plugin root: packages/maind/bin/maind:79 ($REPO_ROOT/../aicore, REPO_ROOT is the plugin root), packages/maind/install.sh:109 ($REPO_ROOT/../..), and packages/maind/skills/swissknifeman-locator/SKILL.md:35 (cd of the binary directory plus ../../..). The same locator line is in packages/analyst/bin/analyst:75, packages/brain/bin/brain:46 and packages/harness/bin/harness:80. None of these files are opened. A static run of the implemented path checks reports 0 problems, so the script prints smoke-installed OK.
findings.reproduction: Read check_plugin sources at scripts/smoke-installed.sh:139-159, then the three maind lines above. The hub-p12#smoke rule is that no file of the copy may contain an executable relative path that resolves outside the plugin root.

triage_reproduction.cmd: T=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $T/home $T/skm $T/copy; git archive --format=tar HEAD:packages/maind | tar -x -C $T/copy; HOME=$T/home SKM_HOME=$T/skm bash scripts/smoke-installed.sh --check-plugin $T/copy --name maind; grep -n '\.\./' $T/copy/bin/maind $T/copy/install.sh
triage_reproduction.observed: Prints 'smoke-installed plugin OK' with exit 0, although the copy has executable climbs out of the plugin root: bin/maind:79 and :80 ($REPO_ROOT/../aicore) and install.sh:109 ($REPO_ROOT/../..). check_plugin only reads plugin.json, hooks/hooks.json and commands/*.md, so no executable file is opened.

findings.failure_scenario: swissknifeman doctor --json prints an object whose schema is umbrella-doctor/v1 and whose keys match configs/schemas/umbrella-doctor.schema.json, but a result row has category outside the enum, $schema other than urn:swissknifeman:aicore:check-result:v1, observed equal to an empty string, or units_without_doctor is a string. The checker only compares key sets and the status enum. It still prints smoke-installed OK. collect_doctor copies provides.doctor[].category into a synthetic row without checking the enum (scripts/umbrella.py:404).
findings.reproduction: Compare scripts/smoke-installed.sh:217-228 with the category enum, $schema const, observed minLength and units_without_doctor items in configs/schemas/umbrella-doctor.schema.json.

triage_reproduction.cmd: python3 -I m.py (scratch script): apply the smoke checker's three conditions (required keys, key subset, status enum) to a row with category 'bogus', observed '' and $schema 'x', using configs/schemas/umbrella-doctor.schema.json
triage_reproduction.observed: Prints True True True, so the row passes. The checker looks only at key sets and the status enum, and ignores the category enum, the $schema const, the observed minLength and the units_without_doctor item type, so the smoke would still print OK.
